meta.title: A late bid that changes the leader extends the auction by the configured minutes
gaps: No setup recipe creates a published rank auction with dynamic closing configured for a one-minute trigger, two-minute extension, rank limit 1, and three QA vendors with the required tied/last ranking.
There is no vendor3Uuid token or operation to invite a third QA vendor.
The available read-back fields do not expose the dynamic-closing settings or support asserting that the auction end time moved by exactly two minutes.
